content.text: Users report that `iwe find --meta depends=foo` returns no results for bare frontmatter documents, even though those documents have a `depends:` field with `- foo` in their front matter. The same query works for documents with fenced YAML (---) front matter. All tests pass. Diagnose and fix. Ensure cargo test still passes after the fix.

content.text:
All tests pass. Here's a summary of the diagnosis and fix.

## Root Cause

`wrap_bare_frontmatter()` in `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs` had a hard-coded guard:

```rust
if !content.starts_with("title: ") {
    return Cow::Borrowed(content);
}
```

This meant bare frontmatter was **only** detected when `title:` was the very first field. TibbitWiki-style documents that start with `created:` or any other field would bypass wrapping entirely — pulldown-cmark would never see fenced `---` metadata, so `get_metadata()` would return `None`, and `--meta` filtering would find nothing.

Fenced documents (`---` delimited) worked because pulldown-cmark handles those natively, regardless of field order.

## Fix

Replaced the `starts_with("title: ")` check with a general YAML key-value heuristic: the first line must contain `: ` preceded by a valid YAML key (alphanumeric, `_`, `-`). This correctly detects any bare frontmatter regardless of which field comes first.

## Files Changed

- **`crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`** — replaced `title: ` guard with general YAML key detection
- **`crates/liwe/tests/find_metadata_test.rs`** — added regression test `bare_frontmatter_sequence_metadata_filter` covering the reported scenario
